injuries.detail: Smith (finger) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Minnesota, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
Claxton (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
Awaka has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
